apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Configuration
metadata:
  name: p1r-private
spec:
  features:
    - name: HotReload
      enabled: false
  nameResolution:
    component: sqlite
    version: v1
    configuration:
      connectionString: "/tmp/p1r-published-8e1f75dd1bea4a57a88ee24ee41a12a7-75b1d0ib/discovery.sqlite"
files.name: discovery.yaml

files.content:
apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: statestore
spec:
  type: state.redis
  version: v1
  metadata:
    - name: redisHost
      value: "127.0.0.1:19757"
    - name: actorStateStore
      value: "true"
scopes:
  - eventstore
files.name: state.yaml
